title: Laundry hygiene during a water shortage
summary: A water-saving clothing routine that protects skin, wounds, infants, bedding, work clothes, and shared shelter areas when normal washing is impossible.
content: Core sequence: 1) Reserve the cleanest cloth for wounds, infants, faces, and underwear instead of washing everything equally. 2) Air clothing in sun or moving air, then brush dry dirt away from cooking and sleeping areas. 3) Wash small high-contact items first: underwear, socks, masks, wound cloths, and pillow covers. 4) Separate contaminated flood, sewage, chemical, or animal-waste clothing until proper washing or disposal is possible.
